description: This file defines language-specific plural rules and number transformations for internationalization, extending the jQuery i18n plugin with locale data and functions.

methods.name: convertPlural
methods.description: Converts a count and list of forms into the correct plural form based on language rules.

methods.name: getPluralForm
methods.description: Determines the plural form index for a given number based on language rules.

methods.name: convertNumber
methods.description: Converts a number into a localized string using digit transformation tables.

methods.name: convertGrammar
methods.description: Placeholder for language-specific grammatical transformations; defaults to returning the input word.

methods.name: gender
methods.description: Returns gender-specific form of a word based on gender parameter.

methods.name: digitTransformTable
methods.description: Provides a digit transformation table for supported languages or false if unavailable.
